description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the two-script workflow. 2. Agent runs `scripts/index-memory.py` from the workspace root, which scans both the root-level `MEMORY.md` AND all `memory/**/*.md` files (the proprietary trap: both locations must be included; distractor files in `archive/`, `.txt`, `.csv` must NOT be indexed). 3. The indexer writes an incremental cache to `memory/cache/index.json`. 4. Agent runs `scripts/search-memory.py 'patent' --top 3` (must use the bespoke `--top` flag, not `-n` or `--limit`). 5. Agent captures the stdout output — which uses the proprietary format `N. [score] path` with recency-boosted scores (1.5× for ≤30 days, 1.2× for ≤90 days) — and saves it verbatim to `search_results.txt`. 6. The output must contain exactly 3 ranked lines; recent patent-related files (e.g., `research/ip/patent_strategy_notes.md` at 20 days old) must appear in the top results because of the recency boost.
